models.name: todo_list_user
models.description:
Primary user identity and authentication record.

Stores user credentials for authentication. Each user has a unique email and hashed password. This entity is the foundation of access control for the Todo List application. All task operations are bound to a user through this identity record. User data is never shared between accounts and is strictly private to each individual.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique and valid.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password. Never stores plain text passwords. Required for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Records initial registration time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated. Automatically updated on any modification to user data.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
User session tracking for authentication.

Stores active and historical browser sessions for authenticated users. Each session is tied to a single user and tracks connection context (IP address, URL, referrer). Sessions are managed exclusively through authentication flows and are referenced for security auditing. This table supports session validation without server-side storage.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User's identity they are authenticated as. {@link todo_list_user.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's public IP address during session initiation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led the user to this application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the session was created. Records session start timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when session expires and must be re-authenticated. Nullable if session never expired.

models.name: todo_list_task

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who created this task. {@link todo_list_user.id}.

foreignFields.name: session_id
foreignFields.description: The session during which the task was created. {@link todo_list_user_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The task description entered by the user, trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the task has been completed. True if completed, false if pending.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the task was marked as completed. Null if task is pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the task was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the task was permanently deleted. Null if not deleted. Used for audit trail, though deletion is irreversible.
